learnSteps: Open the instrument plug-in window and click the knob/slider you want to control
Choose Logic Pro > Control Surfaces > Learn Assignment for [parameter name] (or press Command-L)
Move/send the CC from the browser app (the Controller Assignments window shows it in 'Input message')
Click the Learn Mode button (or press Command-L) to finish
Alternative (Smart Controls): open the Smart Controls pane (press B), click the Inspector button
Select a screen control, click External Assignment, click Learn
Send the CC from the browser app, then click Learn again to stop
setup: Make sure at least one bus exists (default name 'Bus 1'); click Apply
In the browser app, choose 'IAC Driver Bus 1' as the Web MIDI output
In Logic, create or select a Software Instrument track with the instrument loaded
Logic plays the selected/record-enabled instrument track from incoming MIDI inputs (IAC Bus 1 appears as an input once online)

controls.label: Ctrl D (75)
controls.notes: Default Ctrl D = CC#75. Modulation source; preset must route it.

controls.label: Performance control knobs 1-8
controls.notes: Eight per-preset macro knobs (Apple guideline: knobs 2 and 6 often cutoff/resonance, 1 and 5 delay/reverb). No CC by default; use Logic Learn Assignment.

name: Vital
popularity: Widely used free wavetable synth; source code is public (github.com/mtytel/vital); no usage numbers found
defaultChannel: omni (MIDI manager processes every channel; no channel filter in code)

bendRangeSemitones.how: pitch_bend_range parameter, range 0 to 48, default 2 (synth_parameters.cpp); shown in Vital's voice/keyboard settings

controls.label: MOD WHEEL (mod source)
controls.notes: CC1 drives the mod wheel source; it only changes the sound if the preset routes the mod wheel.

controls.label: SLIDE (mod source)
controls.notes: Vital always treats CC74 (MSB) + CC106 (LSB) as the MPE 'Slide' mod source, per channel, even without MPE. It only affects sound if the preset routes Slide. CC74 can also be MIDI-learned in addition.

controls.label: Sustain
controls.notes: CC64 sustain; CC66 sostenuto also handled.

controls.label: CUTOFF
controls.notes: Learn-only. Note CC74 is also the Slide source, so learning cutoff to CC74 is fine but Slide routings will also move. Suggested assignment via MIDI learn (GM2 sound-controller convention); NOT a factory default.

controls.label: RESONANCE
controls.notes: Suggested assignment via MIDI learn (GM2 sound-controller convention); NOT a factory default.

controls.label: ATTACK
controls.notes: Suggested assignment via MIDI learn (GM2 sound-controller convention); NOT a factory default.

controls.label: RELEASE
controls.notes: Suggested assignment via MIDI learn (GM2 sound-controller convention); NOT a factory default.

controls.label: VOLUME
controls.notes: CC7 is NOT handled natively; learn it if needed.
